description: Open a photo or PDF attached to a note, such as an invoice, receipt or scan. Photos come back as images; PDFs as text, plus images of pages without a text layer. Very tall photos and pages come in overlapping parts: read them all before taking figures, and count a repeated line once.

as_images.description: PDF only: also send images of pages that have text.

file.description: Attachment file name from read_note or list_notes.

pages.description: PDF only: page numbers to read, starting at 1. Default: the first 5.

part.description: For very tall photos and PDF pages: which part to show, starting at 1. For a PDF, ask for one page at a time: pages=[N].

name: get_attachment
title: Open an attachment
